provenance: QMCPACK 4.1.0 XSD schema + readthedocs + example analysis

lattice.name: lattice
lattice.description: 3x3 matrix of lattice vectors (9 floats, Bohr). Each row is a lattice vector.

bconds.name: bconds
bconds.description: Boundary conditions per lattice direction, space-separated. 'p'=periodic, 'n'=open.

LR_dim_cutoff.name: LR_dim_cutoff
LR_dim_cutoff.description: Cutoff parameter for long-range Ewald interactions. Higher=more accurate. Typical: 6-15.

rs.name: rs
rs.description: Wigner-Seitz radius for homogeneous electron gas (HEG). condition attrib sets particle count.

scale.name: scale
scale.description: Global scale factor applied to lattice vectors.

qmc_project_id.name: qmc_project_id
qmc_project_id.description: Project identifier, used as prefix for output filenames (project@id attribute).

series.name: series
series.description: Serial number for managing multiple runs (project@series attribute). Auto-incremented in loops.

driver_version.name: driver_version
driver_version.description: QMCPACK driver selector: 'legacy' or 'batched'. Batched driver is default in 4.x.

seed.name: seed
seed.description: RNG seed (random@seed). -1=auto from date/time, positive integer for reproducible runs.

charge.name: charge
charge.description: Charge of particles in a group. Electrons=-1; ions=nuclear or PP valence charge.

valence.name: valence
valence.description: Number of valence electrons for an ionic species (used with pseudopotentials).

atomicnumber.name: atomicnumber
atomicnumber.description: Atomic number Z of an ionic species.

mass.name: mass
mass.description: Particle mass in electron mass units.

determinantset_type.name: determinantset_type
determinantset_type.description: SPO type/builder for the determinant set.

determinantset_href.name: determinantset_href
determinantset_href.description: Path to HDF5 file containing DFT orbitals (for bspline/einspline SPO type).

determinantset_source.name: determinantset_source
determinantset_source.description: Source ion particleset name for orbital centers.

determinantset_tilematrix.name: determinantset_tilematrix
determinantset_tilematrix.description: 3x3 tiling matrix (9 integers) for supercell construction from primitive cell orbitals.

determinantset_twistnum.name: determinantset_twistnum
determinantset_twistnum.description: Twist/k-point index. -1 for auto-detect from twist attribute.

determinantset_meshfactor.name: determinantset_meshfactor
determinantset_meshfactor.description: Mesh density factor for bspline orbital representation. 1.0 is standard.

jastrow_rcut.name: jastrow_rcut
jastrow_rcut.description: Cutoff radius (Bohr) for Jastrow correlation. Beyond this, contribution is zero.

jastrow_cusp.name: jastrow_cusp
jastrow_cusp.description: Cusp value at r=0. Set to 0.0 when using pseudopotentials.

jastrow_size.name: jastrow_size
jastrow_size.description: Number of B-spline knots for Bspline Jastrow.

pairpot_type.name: pairpot_type
pairpot_type.description: Type of pair potential operator in the Hamiltonian.

pairpot_wavefunction.name: pairpot_wavefunction
pairpot_wavefunction.description: Wavefunction name for nonlocal PP evaluation.

pseudo_href.name: pseudo_href
pseudo_href.description: Path to pseudopotential XML file for a specific element.

vmc_blocks.name: blocks
vmc_blocks.description: Number of Monte Carlo blocks for statistical averaging in VMC.

vmc_steps.name: steps
vmc_steps.description: Number of steps per block in VMC.

vmc_substeps.name: substeps
vmc_substeps.description: Substeps per step for cheap decorrelation moves without full evaluation.

vmc_timestep.name: timestep
vmc_timestep.description: VMC timestep controlling Metropolis random walk step size.

vmc_walkers.name: walkers
vmc_walkers.description: Number of walkers per MPI rank (legacy driver). Batch driver auto-manages.

vmc_useDrift.name: useDrift
vmc_useDrift.description: Enable drift in VMC moves. 'no'=pure diffusion, allows larger timestep.

vmc_samples.name: samples
vmc_samples.description: Total samples to collect (legacy driver, feeds DMC/optimization with walkers).

vmc_total_walkers.name: total_walkers
vmc_total_walkers.description: Total walkers across all MPI ranks (batched driver only).

vmc_checkpoint.name: checkpoint
vmc_checkpoint.description: Checkpoint frequency: -1=disable, 0=end-of-run only, N=every N blocks.

dmc_blocks.name: blocks
dmc_blocks.description: Number of DMC blocks for statistical averaging.

dmc_steps.name: steps
dmc_steps.description: Number of steps per block in DMC.

dmc_timestep.name: timestep
dmc_timestep.description: DMC timestep. Should be small for time-step extrapolation (typical: 0.005-0.02).

dmc_targetwalkers.name: targetwalkers
dmc_targetwalkers.description: Target number of walkers for DMC population control.

dmc_nonlocalmoves.name: nonlocalmoves
dmc_nonlocalmoves.description: T-moves for nonlocal PPs. 'yes'=default algo, 'v0'/'v1'/'v3' for specific versions.

dmc_reconfiguration.name: reconfiguration
dmc_reconfiguration.description: Use reconfiguration (fixed population) instead of standard branching DMC.

opt_exp0.name: exp0
opt_exp0.description: Starting exponent for stabilizer (10^exp0) in quartic optimizer.

opt_stepsize.name: stepsize
opt_stepsize.description: Step size for parameter update in quartic line search.

opt_nstabilizers.name: nstabilizers
opt_nstabilizers.description: Number of stabilizer values to try per optimization step.

opt_alloweddifference.name: alloweddifference
opt_alloweddifference.description: Allowed energy difference for optimization convergence check.

opt_bigchange.name: bigchange
opt_bigchange.description: Maximum allowed parameter change per step. Rejects updates exceeding threshold.

opt_minwalkers.name: minwalkers
opt_minwalkers.description: Minimum fraction of walkers surviving reweighting for update acceptance.

opt_shift_i.name: shift_i
opt_shift_i.description: Identity shift for adaptive optimizer (Levenberg-Marquardt regularization).

opt_max_param_change.name: max_param_change
opt_max_param_change.description: Maximum allowed parameter change per optimization step (adaptive method).

cost_energy.name: energy
cost_energy.description: Weight of energy in optimization cost function (0.0 to 1.0). All cost weights sum to 1.

cost_unreweightedvariance.name: unreweightedvariance
cost_unreweightedvariance.description: Weight of unreweighted variance in optimization cost function.

cost_reweightedvariance.name: reweightedvariance
cost_reweightedvariance.description: Weight of reweighted variance in optimization cost function.

loop_max.name: max
loop_max.description: Maximum loop iterations. project@series auto-increments each iteration.

include_href.name: href
include_href.description: Path to external XML file to include (inlined at this position).

estimator_type.name: type
estimator_type.description: Estimator type for observable measurements during QMC runs.
